run_hydra_app: run a minimal Hydra application that loads config from the conf directory
run_my_app: run the my_app function decorated with hydra.main to parse CLI config overrides
test_hydra_config_loading: test that the Hydra app correctly loads config from conf/config.yaml
test_hydra_free_group: test the Hydra app with a free group config override on the command line
review_hydra_main_decorator: review the hydra.main decorator usage with version_base, config_path, and config_name
